mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO benefit ( plcy_no, plcy_nm, category_code, detail_category_code, sprvsn_inst_cd_nm, target_desc, plcy_sprt_cn, support_amount, plcy_aply_mthd_cn, sbmsn_dcmnt_cn, apply_start_date, apply_end_date, aply_ymd, aply_prd_se_cd, aply_url_addr, ref_url_addr1, sprt_trgt_min_age, sprt_trgt_max_age, earn_cnd_se_cd, earn_min_amt, earn_max_amt, earn_etc_cn, mrg_stts_cd, conflict_group_code, inq_cnt, is_active, api_deleted_yn, api_deleted_dt, frst_reg_dt, last_mdfcn_dt, plcy_expln_cn )
VALUES ( #{plcyNo}, #{plcyNm}, #{categoryCode}, #{detailCategoryCode}, #{sprvsnInstCdNm}, #{targetDesc}, #{plcySprtCn}, #{supportAmount}, #{plcyAplyMthdCn}, #{sbmsnDcmntCn}, #{applyStartDate}, #{applyEndDate}, #{aplyYmd}, NULLIF(TRIM(#{aplyPrdSeCd}), ''), #{aplyUrlAddr}, #{refUrlAddr1}, #{sprtTrgtMinAge}, #{sprtTrgtMaxAge}, NULLIF(TRIM(#{earnCndSeCd}), ''), #{earnMinAmt}, #{earnMaxAmt}, #{earnEtcCn}, NULLIF(TRIM(#{mrgSttsCd}), ''), #{conflictGroupCode}, IFNULL(#{inqCnt}, 0), IFNULL(#{isActive}, 'Y'), 'N', NULL, IFNULL(#{frstRegDt}, NOW()), NOW(), #{plcyExplnCn} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE plcy_nm = VALUES(plcy_nm), category_code = VALUES(category_code), detail_category_code = VALUES(detail_category_code), sprvsn_inst_cd_nm = VALUES(sprvsn_inst_cd_nm), target_desc = VALUES(target_desc), plcy_sprt_cn = VALUES(plcy_sprt_cn), support_amount = VALUES(support_amount), plcy_aply_mthd_cn = VALUES(plcy_aply_mthd_cn), sbmsn_dcmnt_cn = VALUES(sbmsn_dcmnt_cn), apply_start_date = VALUES(apply_start_date), apply_end_date = VALUES(apply_end_date), aply_ymd = VALUES(aply_ymd), aply_prd_se_cd = NULLIF(TRIM(VALUES(aply_prd_se_cd)), ''), aply_url_addr = VALUES(aply_url_addr), ref_url_addr1 = VALUES(ref_url_addr1), sprt_trgt_min_age = VALUES(sprt_trgt_min_age), sprt_trgt_max_age = VALUES(sprt_trgt_max_age), earn_cnd_se_cd = NULLIF(TRIM(VALUES(earn_cnd_se_cd)), ''), earn_min_amt = VALUES(earn_min_amt), earn_max_amt = VALUES(earn_max_amt), earn_etc_cn = VALUES(earn_etc_cn), mrg_stts_cd = NULLIF(TRIM(VALUES(mrg_stts_cd)), ''), inq_cnt = VALUES(inq_cnt), is_active = VALUES(is_active), api_deleted_yn = 'N', api_deleted_dt = NULL, last_mdfcn_dt = NOW(), plcy_expln_cn = VALUES(plcy_expln_cn)
mapper.update: UPDATE benefit SET inq_cnt = #{inqCnt}, is_active = #{isActive}, api_deleted_yn = 'N', api_deleted_dt = NULL, last_mdfcn_dt = NOW() WHERE plcy_no = #{plcyNo}
mapper.select: SELECT category_code AS categoryCode, category_name AS categoryName, display_order AS displayOrder FROM benefit_category ORDER BY display_order ASC

SELECT r.zip_cd AS zipCd, r.region_name AS regionName, r.parent_region_code AS parentRegionCode,
CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM region child WHERE child.parent_region_code = r.zip_cd ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS hasChildren
FROM region r
WHERE r.parent_region_code IS NULL
WHERE r.parent_region_code = #{parentRegionCode}
ORDER BY r.zip_cd ASC

SELECT code AS plcyMajorCd, code_name AS codeName, display_order AS displayOrder FROM common_code WHERE group_code = '0011' AND api_field = 'plcyMajorCd' AND is_active = 'Y' AND code != '0011009' ORDER BY display_order ASC, code ASC

SELECT code AS schoolCd, code_name AS codeName, display_order AS displayOrder FROM common_code WHERE group_code = '0049' AND api_field = 'schoolCd' AND is_active = 'Y' AND code != '0049010' ORDER BY display_order ASC, code ASC

SELECT code AS jobCd, code_name AS codeName, display_order AS displayOrder FROM common_code WHERE group_code = '0013' AND api_field = 'jobCd' AND is_active = 'Y' AND code != '0013010' ORDER BY display_order ASC, code ASC

SELECT code AS mrgSttsCd, code_name AS codeName, display_order AS displayOrder FROM common_code WHERE group_code = '0055' AND api_field = 'mrgSttsCd' AND is_active = 'Y' AND code != '0055003' ORDER BY display_order ASC, code ASC

WITH RECURSIVE region_scope AS ( SELECT r.zip_cd, r.parent_region_code FROM region r WHERE r.zip_cd = #{zipCd}
UNION ALL
SELECT child.zip_cd, child.parent_region_code FROM region child INNER JOIN region_scope parent ON child.parent_region_code = parent.zip_cd )
SELECT b.benefit_no AS benefitNo, b.plcy_no AS plcyNo, b.plcy_nm AS plcyNm, b.category_code AS categoryCode, bc.category_name AS categoryName, b.sprvsn_inst_cd_nm AS sprvsnInstCdNm, b.apply_start_date AS applyStartDate, b.apply_end_date AS applyEndDate, b.aply_prd_se_cd AS aplyPrdSeCd, b.is_active AS isActive,
CASE WHEN b.is_active = 'N' THEN 'CLOSED'
WHEN b.aply_prd_se_cd = '0057003' THEN 'CLOSED'
WHEN b.apply_end_date IS NOT NULL AND b.apply_end_date < CURDATE() THEN 'CLOSED'
WHEN b.apply_end_date IS NULL THEN 'ALWAYS'
ELSE 'OPEN' END AS benefitStatus
FROM benefit b JOIN benefit_category bc ON b.category_code = bc.category_code
WHERE 1 = 1 AND IFNULL(b.api_deleted_yn, 'N') = 'N'
AND b.category_code = #{categoryCode}
AND ( b.plcy_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.plcy_expln_cn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.plcy_sprt_cn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM benefit_region br WHERE br.benefit_no = b.benefit_no AND br.zip_cd IN ( SELECT zip_cd FROM region_scope ) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM benefit_major bm WHERE bm.benefit_no = b.benefit_no AND ( bm.plcy_major_cd = #{plcyMajorCd} OR bm.plcy_major_cd = '0011009' ) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM benefit_school bs WHERE bs.benefit_no = b.benefit_no AND ( bs.school_cd = #{schoolCd} OR bs.school_cd = '0049010' ) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM benefit_job bj WHERE bj.benefit_no = b.benefit_no AND ( bj.job_cd = #{jobCd} OR bj.job_cd = '0013010' ) )
AND ( b.mrg_stts_cd = #{mrgSttsCd} OR b.mrg_stts_cd = '0055003' )
AND ( ( b.sprt_trgt_min_age IS NULL OR b.sprt_trgt_min_age = 0 OR b.sprt_trgt_min_age <= #{age} ) AND ( b.sprt_trgt_max_age IS NULL OR b.sprt_trgt_max_age = 0 OR b.sprt_trgt_max_age >= #{age} ) )
AND b.detail_category_code IN
#{code}
ORDER BY CASE -- 신청 가능한 기간제 혜택 WHEN b.is_active = 'Y' AND b.aply_prd_se_cd != '0057003' AND b.apply_end_date IS NOT NULL AND b.apply_end_date >= CURDATE() THEN 0
-- 신청 가능한 상시 혜택 WHEN b.is_active = 'Y' AND b.aply_prd_se_cd != '0057003' AND b.apply_end_date IS NULL THEN 1
-- 비활성 또는 마감 혜택 ELSE 2 END ASC,
CASE WHEN b.is_active = 'Y' AND b.aply_prd_se_cd != '0057003' AND b.apply_end_date IS NOT NULL AND b.apply_end_date >= CURDATE() THEN b.apply_end_date END ASC,
b.benefit_no DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.detail_category_name
FROM goal_benefit_category g JOIN benefit_detail_category d ON d.detail_category_code = g.detail_category_code
WHERE g.goal_type = #{goalType} AND g.priority = #{priority}
ORDER BY d.display_order
SELECT keyword_code AS keywordCode, keyword_name AS keywordName, display_order AS displayOrder FROM recommend_keyword WHERE is_active = 'Y' ORDER BY display_order ASC, keyword_code ASC

SELECT benefit_no AS benefitNo, plcy_no AS plcyNo, plcy_nm AS plcyNm, category_code AS categoryCode, sprvsn_inst_cd_nm AS sprvsnInstCdNm, DATE_FORMAT(apply_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS applyStartDate, DATE_FORMAT(apply_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS applyEndDate, aply_prd_se_cd AS aplyPrdSeCd, sprt_trgt_min_age AS sprtTrgtMinAge, sprt_trgt_max_age AS sprtTrgtMaxAge, earn_cnd_se_cd AS earnCndSeCd, earn_max_amt AS earnMaxAmt, mrg_stts_cd AS mrgSttsCd, is_active AS isActive, inq_cnt AS inqCnt FROM benefit WHERE plcy_no = #{plcyNo}

SELECT b.benefit_no AS benefitNo, b.plcy_no AS plcyNo, b.plcy_nm AS plcyNm,
b.category_code AS categoryCode, bc.category_name AS categoryName,
b.sprvsn_inst_cd_nm AS sprvsnInstCdNm, b.target_desc AS targetDesc,
b.plcy_expln_cn AS plcyExplnCn, b.plcy_sprt_cn AS plcySprtCn, b.support_amount AS supportAmount,
b.plcy_aply_mthd_cn AS plcyAplyMthdCn, b.sbmsn_dcmnt_cn AS sbmsnDcmntCn,
b.apply_start_date AS applyStartDate, b.apply_end_date AS applyEndDate, b.aply_ymd AS aplyYmd, b.aply_prd_se_cd AS aplyPrdSeCd, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(b.custom_apply_url), ''), b.aply_url_addr) AS aplyUrlAddr, b.ref_url_addr1 AS refUrlAddr1, b.sprt_trgt_min_age AS sprtTrgtMinAge, b.sprt_trgt_max_age AS sprtTrgtMaxAge,
b.earn_cnd_se_cd AS earnCndSeCd, b.earn_min_amt AS earnMinAmt, b.earn_max_amt AS earnMaxAmt, b.earn_etc_cn AS earnEtcCn,
b.mrg_stts_cd AS mrgSttsCd, b.inq_cnt AS inqCnt, b.is_active AS isActive,
CASE WHEN b.is_active = 'N' THEN 'CLOSED'
WHEN b.aply_prd_se_cd = '0057003' THEN 'CLOSED'
WHEN b.apply_end_date IS NOT NULL AND b.apply_end_date < CURDATE() THEN 'CLOSED'
WHEN b.apply_end_date IS NULL THEN 'ALWAYS'
ELSE 'OPEN' END AS benefitStatus
FROM benefit b
LEFT JOIN benefit_category bc ON bc.category_code = b.category_code
WHERE b.benefit_no = #{benefitNo} AND IFNULL(b.api_deleted_yn, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT mp.member_no AS memberNo,
TIMESTAMPDIFF( YEAR, mp.birth_date, CURDATE() ) AS age,
CASE
WHEN p.zip_cd IS NULL OR p.zip_cd = '00000' THEN r.zip_cd
WHEN gp.zip_cd IS NULL OR gp.zip_cd = '00000' THEN p.zip_cd
ELSE gp.zip_cd END AS provinceCode,
CASE WHEN p.zip_cd IS NULL OR p.zip_cd = '00000' THEN r.region_name
WHEN gp.zip_cd IS NULL OR gp.zip_cd = '00000' THEN p.region_name
ELSE gp.region_name END AS provinceName,
CASE
WHEN p.zip_cd IS NULL OR p.zip_cd = '00000' THEN NULL
WHEN gp.zip_cd IS NULL OR gp.zip_cd = '00000' THEN r.zip_cd
ELSE p.zip_cd END AS cityCode,
CASE WHEN p.zip_cd IS NULL OR p.zip_cd = '00000' THEN NULL
WHEN gp.zip_cd IS NULL OR gp.zip_cd = '00000' THEN TRIM( REPLACE( r.region_name, CONCAT(p.region_name, ' '), '' ) )
ELSE TRIM( REPLACE( p.region_name, CONCAT(gp.region_name, ' '), '' ) ) END AS cityName,
CASE
WHEN gp.zip_cd IS NOT NULL AND gp.zip_cd != '00000' THEN r.zip_cd ELSE NULL END AS districtCode,
CASE WHEN gp.zip_cd IS NOT NULL AND gp.zip_cd != '00000' THEN TRIM( REPLACE( r.region_name, CONCAT(p.region_name, ' '), '' ) )
ELSE NULL END AS districtName,
mp.major AS plcyMajorCd, major_code.code_name AS majorName,
mp.education AS schoolCd, school_code.code_name AS schoolName,
mp.employ_status AS jobCd, job_code.code_name AS jobName,
mp.mrg_stts_cd AS mrgSttsCd, marriage_code.code_name AS marriageName
FROM member_profile mp
LEFT JOIN region r ON r.zip_cd = mp.region_code
LEFT JOIN region p ON p.zip_cd = r.parent_region_code
LEFT JOIN region gp ON gp.zip_cd = p.parent_region_code
LEFT JOIN common_code major_code ON major_code.code = mp.major AND major_code.api_field = 'plcyMajorCd' AND major_code.is_active = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN common_code school_code ON school_code.code = mp.education AND school_code.api_field = 'schoolCd' AND school_code.is_active = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN common_code job_code ON job_code.code = mp.employ_status AND job_code.api_field = 'jobCd' AND job_code.is_active = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN common_code marriage_code ON marriage_code.code = mp.mrg_stts_cd AND marriage_code.api_field = 'mrgSttsCd' AND marriage_code.is_active = 'Y'
WHERE mp.member_no = #{memberNo}
mapper.update:
UPDATE benefit SET is_active = 'N', api_deleted_yn = 'Y', api_deleted_dt = NOW(), last_mdfcn_dt = NOW() WHERE api_deleted_yn = 'N' AND plcy_no NOT IN
#{plcyNo}
UPDATE benefit SET api_deleted_yn = 'N', api_deleted_dt = NULL WHERE plcy_no = #{plcyNo}
